dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anyone looking after you?

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. Who'd want a nagging old man weighing him down anyway? It's not like he's my own flesh and blood...

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: *Sigh* Why did he have to go hunting so far out? It's not like I would've starved to death without a bite of meat...
